name: Hallasan
note: East rim summit (한라산 동릉 정상), where the trails end. The true summit on the west rim of the crater is closed to hikers.

name: Mauna Kea
note: Where the summit hike tops out (4,200 m). The summit cone, Puʻu Wēkiu, is about 250 m further on and is a sacred site visitors are asked not to climb.

name: Mount Fuji
note: Top of the Yoshida route at Kusushi Shrine, on the crater rim. Kengamine (剣ヶ峰), the true 3,776 m summit, is about 700 m round the rim and still counts on its own; this replaces only OSM's 富士山 node in the middle of the crater, which no trail reaches.
